data: This course is a sequel to Microeconomics II specially designed for the students enrolled in the FYUP. It will focus on the study of market failure under second best settings. It will also dwell deeper into game theory, public goods, factor markets, and time costs. The concept of the market equilibrium will be re-introduced, and we will learn how the characteristics of the market vary in the real word leading to conditions such that market fails to achieve an equilibrium, focusing on externalities, public goods, markets with asymmetric information and imperfect competition. The course would develop a rigorous set of tools to analyze such conditions while unraveling how choices can interact and persist leading to strategic outcomes and payoffs.
